meta.name: balance-sheet
meta.description: Build a balance sheet (bilan) from a Well workspace. Use when the user asks for a balance sheet, bilan, assets/liabilities/equity, or financial position at a point in time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 Well 工作区自动生成资产负债表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速从 Well 数据生成资产负债表。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a balance sheet from a Well workspace
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce a balance sheet from Well data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据您的 Well 工作空间中的已过账总账数据，生成指定日期（as-of date）的资产负债表。它会按资产（Actif）和负债/权益（Passif）两大类别分组并显示小计，同时检查两边是否平衡（Actif = Passif ✓/✗）。如果总账为空，则回退显示现金头寸并标注。
howto.when: 当您要求生成资产负债表、bilan、资产/负债/权益，或询问某个时间点的财务状况时触发。

say.text: 请根据我的 Well 工作空间生成截至今天的资产负债表。
say.note: 需要 Well 中已有已过账总账数据。

say.text: 帮我查一下上个月底的资产和负债情况。
我的公司需要一份资产负债表，从 Well 里拉数据。

howto.what_en: Claude uses posted ledger data from your Well workspace to build a point-in-time balance sheet. It groups accounts into assets (Actif) and liabilities/equity (Passif), shows subtotals, and checks if total assets equal total liabilities/equity. Falls back to cash position if ledger is empty.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a balance sheet, bilan, assets/liabilities/equity, or financial position at a point in time.

say_en.text: Generate a balance sheet from my Well workspace as of today.
say_en.note: Requires posted ledger data in Well.

say_en.text: Check my assets and liabilities as of last month end.
I need a balance sheet for my company using Well data.
